title: HullQ Brand-BoatModel Relationship v0.1
description: An independently identifiable relationship between a Brand and a BoatModel. Supports multiple historical associations and optional applicability boundaries. A BoatModel may have zero Brand relationships when evidence is insufficient.

brand_id.description: Reference to the Brand entity ID.

boat_model_id.description: Reference to the BoatModel entity ID.

first_year.description: First year this Brand marketed this BoatModel. Null when unknown.

last_year.description: Last year this Brand marketed this BoatModel. Null when unknown or still active.

hull_number_from.description: Inclusive hull/build number boundary from. Null when unknown.

hull_number_to.description: Inclusive hull/build number boundary to. Null when unknown.

market.description: Optional market/region label when relationship was region-specific.
